item.title: BCCI Announces 15-member squad for ICC Men’s U-19 World Cup
item.description: The Board of Control for Cricket in India (BCCI) has announced a 15-member squad for the upcoming ICC Men’s Under-19 World Cup, scheduled to be held in Zimbabwe and Namibia from 15th of January to 6th of February, 2026. The squad will be led by Ayush Mhatre, while Vihaan Malhotra will be the Vice Captain. Vaibhav Sooryavanshi, Aaron George and Abhigyan Kundu are also part of the squad. Five-time champions India have been placed in Group B alongside Bangladesh, New Zealand and the United States.
